@graph.name: AI Visibility for HVAC Companies
@graph.description: Measuring and improving whether HVAC companies are named in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI answers, using reviews, third-party mentions and citable service pages, tracked to sold jobs.

mainEntity.name: If my HVAC company ranks in the map pack, will AI recommend it too?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often for the top spot, but not reliably for the rest. In our HVAC data, the company AI named first was usually one Google already showed. Across all the HVAC companies AI named, though, about six in ten were outside Google’s 3-pack and top 10, so a map ranking doesn’t guarantee you’re in the answer.

mainEntity.name: Do schema markup or an llms.txt file get an HVAC company into AI answers?

acceptedAnswer.text: We haven’t seen evidence that they do. In our study, schema markup made no measurable difference to which businesses AI named, and we haven’t tested llms.txt. Reviews, recent reviews and mentions on other websites were the signals that lined up with being named.

mainEntity.name: Can national franchises crowd a local HVAC company out of AI answers?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the local answers we tested, they mostly didn’t. When we asked for the best HVAC company in a city, nearly every company named was a locally branded company, and national franchise names made up only 3 to 5% of mentions. National studies that mix in brand and software questions show franchises doing better, so it depends on what the homeowner asks.

mainEntity.name: How do I find out whether AI recommends my HVAC company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ask the way a homeowner would: “best HVAC company in [your city]” and “who should I call for a new AC in [your city],” in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google’s AI Mode, and repeat each one a few times, because answers change from run to run. Note who gets named and which websites the answer cites. That list tells you where the evidence about your competitors lives.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to start showing up in AI answers?

acceptedAnswer.text: We don’t promise a timeline. The answers change from month to month and from engine to engine, which is why we re-check every month and report what moved, alongside the calls and jobs that came from it.
